mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals a weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS declined over the previous three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in a month, coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000, signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% and PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which positively impacts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increased over the previous three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month, coupled with a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), signals a disinflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL decreases > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% and FEDFUNDS decreased in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two quarters signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 increased over the previous two quarters.
